02 / Visual field guide

Watch face guide

Follow the face from the weather forecast at the top to your step count at the bottom.

Weather icons

The forecast icons show morning, noon and night. Weather requires a location and Bluetooth syncing with Garmin Connect. An unavailable or unsupported reading appears as --.

Clear day
Clear night
Partly day
Partly night
Cloudy
Rain
Storm
Snow

Weather row settings

Weather layouts are Three forecast icons, Wind direction / wind speed, Wind direction / UV index and Wind speed / UV index. Wind speed follows your distance units.

Training status

Training status appears only in the Original and Next sunrise/sunset + moonrise/moonset Sun/Moon layouts.

Strained
Unproductive
Overreaching
Maintaining
Detraining
Productive

Sun and moon row settings

Sun/Moon layouts are Original, Next sunrise/sunset + moonrise/moonset, Centered moon + sunrise/sunset / no training and Next moon + sun events / no training. Moon events require a weather location.

Weekly streak icons

Each circle starts with a weekday letter. Once you log an activity, the longest activity for that day determines the icon.

For example, a 45-minute ride and a 20-minute run show the cycling icon.

Cycling

Other / unknown activity

Shown when the activity type is unrecognized.

Swimming

Training

Running

When no activity is logged

Today or a past day · no activity

A filled white background with the weekday letter means the day is today or has passed, with no activity logged yet. T means Tuesday in this example.

Future day

The patterned letter marks an upcoming day.

2

Alarm count

The number beside the clock shows how many alarms are set.

3

Notification count

The number beside the bell shows your notification count.

Small metrics

Choose running or cycling distance, weather or watch temperature, and running or cycling VO₂ max. Available readings depend on the watch and its recorded data.

Date

The date sits above the time digits. Set its color in the week streak and date controls.

Time fonts

Choose a time font to change the hour and minute digits. Larger fonts may leave less room for side controls.

Original segmented
Alternate
Angular 29 x 49 and native Angular
Grid pixel centered and native side panel

Time controls

On supported layouts, Show time controls toggles the AM/PM indicator and battery display. Seconds and the heartbeat animation are limited when the display is inactive.

Face layouts

Face layouts are Original layout, Corner brackets, Clean centered / no week streak, Clean centered / Crosshair ruler and Clean centered / Split rails.

Side Heart panel designs

Open Settings → Side Heart panel design and select one of these four designs.

DESIGN 01

Original dual gauge

Two gauges display a selected pair of metrics.

DESIGN 02

Red box arch — compact layout

A compact segmented arch displays your selected metric.

DESIGN 03

Eight-segment HR ring

An eight-segment ring displays your selected metric.

DESIGN 04

Diamond bead ring + micro stats

A bead ring with micro stats displays your selected metric.

Choose the metric

For the red box arch, eight-segment ring, or diamond bead ring, choose the data to display: Heart rate, Stress, Steps goal, Watch battery, Body Battery, or Solar intensity.

Two metrics · Original dual gauge only

Bottom metrics

Choose four two-digit fields or three three-digit fields. Choose sleep, recovery, Body Battery, heart rate, distance, floors, intensity minutes or 7-day average HR for individual fields.

Steps

The footsteps icon marks the daily step count beneath the bottom metrics.

03 / Settings map

Quick setting reference

From the watch face shown here, press the top-right button (Edit) and select Customize.

Design

Design 1 is the default. Each preset sets the colors, time font, layout, weather row and sun/moon row. You can then adjust individual settings.

Color theme

Default uses the dark tactical palette. Black on white reverses the black and white elements while keeping the red, amber, green and blue status colors.
